behaviors.behavior: AC-1: an overdue lead (staleness===stale) renders 'Overdue', never 'Resting'
behaviors.evidence: LeadCard.test.tsx AC-1 case; E2E org-page.register.spec.ts 'a lead well past its cadence reads Overdue on the real page, never Resting'

behaviors.behavior: AC-2: staleness===unknown renders the worded cadenceUnresolvedReason and is never confused with fresh
behaviors.evidence: LeadCard.test.tsx: invalid_cron wording, org_chart_invalid wording ('cadence not configured for this lead'), and unknown-with-no-named-reason falling to the load-bearing default case

behaviors.behavior: AC-3: register.status===open renders a finding + Release button; clear renders neither
behaviors.evidence: LeadRegisterFinding.test.tsx 'renders nothing for a clear register' + 'an open entry shows a finding...'

behaviors.behavior: AC-4: clicking Release POSTs sessionId+reason, and a 200 response clears the finding via query invalidation
behaviors.evidence: LeadRegisterFinding.test.tsx 'an open entry shows a finding naming the beat and a working Release button'; E2E org-page.register.spec.ts 'an open register entry shows a finding with a Release button; releasing it closes the entry for real' (real on-disk closedAt + single audit line asserted)

behaviors.behavior: AC-5: org-schema-sync.test.ts stays green with the widened LeadLastRunView/LeadRegisterView kept in lock-step
behaviors.evidence: org-schema-sync.test.ts full suite green (both interfaces and discriminated unions registered and checked per-arm)

behaviors.behavior: AC-6: a beat-register read failure (symlink, corrupt JSON) degrades BOTH now and register to unmeasured/unknown in the same request, never clear
behaviors.evidence: org-leads-staleness-register.test.ts symlink test (now+register) and corrupt-JSON test (now+register, the missing now assertion added this session per code-review finding #2)

behaviors.behavior: AC-7: register.status===fault (duplicate sessionId) names the session with no release button
behaviors.evidence: LeadRegisterFinding.test.tsx fault case; org-leads-staleness-register.test.ts + org-leads-beat-register-release.test.ts duplicate-session-id tests (409, never picks one)

behaviors.behavior: AC-8: createOrgApiRouter with neither lstatSync nor now supplied still serves the release route without throwing
behaviors.evidence: org-leads-beat-register-release.test.ts: two tests deliberately construct the router with no test-only deps (unregistered-lead 403 case and the real-release-success case)

behaviors.behavior: AC-9: an unregistered leadId is refused 403 before any register file is touched
behaviors.evidence: org-leads-beat-register-release.test.ts 'refuses an unregistered leadId (403) BEFORE touching the register'

behaviors.behavior: Cross-lead sessionId isolation: a sessionId belonging to a DIFFERENT lead's register never releases that lead's entry through this lead's route (external-review fix)
behaviors.evidence: org-leads-beat-register-release.test.ts 'a sessionId that belongs to a DIFFERENT lead's register is not-found, never releases the other lead's entry' — asserts 404 AND the other lead's on-disk entry stays closedAt:null

behaviors.behavior: A whitespace-only release reason is rejected both client-side (no network call) and server-side (400, even bypassing the UI) (external-review fixes, GLM + OpenAI)
behaviors.evidence: LeadRegisterFinding.test.tsx 'a whitespace-only reason makes no network call...'; org-leads-beat-register-release.test.ts 'a whitespace-only reason is rejected 400 before any register access'

behaviors.behavior: A thrown ApiError from the release fetcher (locked/invalid/forbidden) surfaces its code visibly and still invalidates the roster
behaviors.evidence: LeadRegisterFinding.test.tsx 'a thrown ApiError (e.g. symlink_forbidden, beat_register_locked) surfaces its code visibly...'

behaviors.behavior: The finding's error/releasing state resets when the register entry's identity changes, so a stale error never misattributes to a new entry (code-review fix #1)
behaviors.evidence: LeadRegisterFinding.test.tsx 'an error clears when the register entry's identity changes'

behaviors.behavior: The client's register-status branching has a runtime exhaustiveness guard, not an implicit fallthrough (doubt-review fix)
behaviors.evidence: LeadRegisterFinding.tsx: `never` assertion before the open-status render; covered indirectly by every status-branch test continuing to pass (the guard is unreachable on the current 4-arm union by construction, verified via tsc)

behaviors.behavior: Full pre-existing org-page E2E flows (absent chart, invalid chart, threads, charter edit) are unaffected by the widened types
behaviors.evidence: E2E org-page.spec.ts: all 5 pre-existing scenarios green in the same isolated-stack run

behaviors.behavior: Existing client/server suites and both workspaces' typecheck are unaffected
behaviors.evidence: Full client (3805) + server (3901/3 skipped) suites pass; tsc --noEmit clean both workspaces; oxlint clean (no new warnings in touched files)

surface_verification.justification: Staleness wording and the beat-register release action (a real file lock + mutation + audit-log append) are behaviors invisible to jsdom unit tests — verified in real Chromium via the project's isolated-stack Playwright harness (client/e2e/flows/org-page.register.spec.ts + the pre-existing org-page.spec.ts), asserting real on-disk artifacts (register closedAt, a single beat_recovered audit line) and the native window.prompt dialog flow, not just DOM state. 7/7 tests passed.
